_comment: Burlington/Vermont artists. HAND-CURATED — this is the one file in the music pipeline a person owns, and it is deliberately not scraped. `threads` is how many distinct r/burlington or r/vermont threads named the artist, which is what ranked them; every entry had a verification URL at the time it was added. To add an artist: name, a link people can actually follow, and ideally one line in a local's voice. To remove one: delete the object. Nothing else reads a name that is not in here, which is what stops the build inventing bands.
_sources: Seven Days music section and the 2026 Seven Daysies
Seven Days, Vermont's Top 10 Hip-Hop Albums of 2024, and the reviews it links
Bandcamp's autocomplete API, for the artist's own stated location

artists.name: Rough Francis
artists.why: The most-recommended band in a decade of threads. The members are sons of Death — yes, that Death.

artists.name: Cooked
artists.why: The name that ends every “is there even a scene here” argument.

artists.name: Greg Freeman
artists.why: “If Greg Freeman has 0 fans I'm not on this earth anymore.”

artists.name: Roost.World
artists.why: Live synthesizer sets — the answer when someone asks for anything that isn't folk or jam.

artists.name: Troy Millette & the Fire Below
artists.why: Sad yet upbeat folk songs about his exes, with tons of humour.

artists.name: The Wormdogs
artists.why: Best Band in the 2026 Seven Daysies. There is a phone hotline: (802) WORMDOG.

artists.name: Robber Robber
artists.why: The one with national traction. New album, Two Wheels Move The Soul.

artists.name: Lily Seabird
artists.why: Named in the same breath as Greg Freeman and Robber Robber, every time.

artists.name: Dari Bay
artists.why: Robber Robber's drummer's project. The newest solo record is the one people press on you.

artists.name: Old North End
artists.why: Named ONE. The band posts in the threads themselves.

artists.name: All Night Boogie Band
artists.why: “All Night Boogie Band never let me down.” Had the Nectar's Wednesday residency.

artists.name: Burning Monk
artists.why: Rage Against the Machine tribute. Locals argue about whether they count as local; consensus is yes.

artists.name: The Edd
artists.why: Named across four threads with no elaboration — the mark of an assumed-known band.

artists.name: Brunch
artists.why: “I work on these guys' guitars and they are absolutely decent humans with great talent.”

artists.name: Greaseface
artists.why: On constant rotation for the people who name it.

artists.name: Vallory Falls
artists.why: Members post in threads looking for shows.

artists.name: Clive
artists.why: “clive all day all night.” Phish and Zappa in a blender, and the guitarist just rips.

artists.name: Forest Station
artists.why: At the top of the Vermont bluegrass scene.

artists.name: Milton Busker & the Grim Work
artists.why: Suit-folk. “If you like Noah Kahan and diving deeper into lyrics — that's your VT band.”

artists.name: Cricket Blue
artists.why: “Taylor and Laura are amazing people and so talented.”

artists.name: The Bubs
artists.why: “Some of the most fun shows I've been to.” Start with Make a Mess.

artists.name: The Tenderbellies
artists.why: “As good as I've experienced, so good.”

artists.name: Seth Yacovone
artists.why: “One of the greatest guitarists and most soulful musicians you'll find anywhere.”

artists.name: Bob Wagner
artists.why: Recommended as a person, not a band: “Rough Francis and anything Bob Wagner is involved in.”

artists.name: LaMP
artists.why: Lawton, Metzger and Paczkowski. Best Jam Band Other Than Phish.

artists.name: Kat Wright
artists.why: The voice of a hundred Burlington summer nights.

artists.name: Rangus
artists.why: “A bunch of folks in the Rangus crew are in various other bands around here.”

artists.name: Fisher Wagg
artists.why: “Fisher Wagg just put out my favorite song of the year.”

artists.name: Phantom Suns
artists.why: “Killer band!”

artists.name: Wild Leek River
artists.why: “Rootin' tootin' boot scootin' good time.” Honky Tonk Tuesday regulars.

artists.name: Ponyhustle
artists.why: Best Country Band in the 2026 Chrisanthemums.

artists.name: Soule Monde
artists.why: Russ Lawton and Ray Paczkowski, as a duo.

artists.name: Reid Parsons
artists.why: “By far the best!”

artists.name: Three Piece Meal
artists.why: “Funky jazz project. Very cool.”

artists.name: Dwight & Nicole
artists.why: New record, Day or Night.

artists.name: Nastee
artists.why: The AfterLyfe founder and VT Union veteran every generation of 802 rap gives props to.

artists.name: Konflik
artists.why: One of the established rappers who gets love from every corner of the state.

artists.name: Charlie Mayne
artists.why: Named alongside Konflik and D.FRENCH whenever anyone lists who is established here.

artists.name: D.FRENCH
artists.why: The St. Albans rapper whose All Saints Day made the 2024 top ten.

artists.name: Mister Burns
artists.why: Lynguistic Civilians veteran who has never stopped booking — he brought Talib Kweli and the Pharcyde here.

artists.name: The Lynguistic Civilians
artists.why: Making music in Burlington since 2009, and the group Mister Burns came out of.

artists.name: The Funky Diabetic
artists.why: Universally hailed as the hardest worker with the best live set.

artists.name: Mavstar
artists.why: Boom-bap loyalist. Verona is a whole record for his mother.

artists.name: Juicebox
artists.why: Turned skateboarding into Ollies in the Hallway, one of the best 802 rap records of 2024.

artists.name: Topia
artists.why: Self-produced KO RABWA was the record other rappers kept naming in 2024.

artists.name: Flywlkr
artists.why: Rapper, producer, and half of “Wave Cave” on 105.9 the Radiator — the show the scene actually listens to.

artists.name: maari
artists.why: Former 99 Neighbors MC. All Is Fair in Love & War, made with Es-K, kept the run going.

artists.name: Es-K
artists.why: Burlington beatmaker fifteen records deep, and the producer half of maari’s best year.

artists.name: Caleb Lodish
artists.why: The producer other rappers cite for obsessive craft and a range well past rap beats.

artists.name: Rico James
artists.why: Delivered a record label’s worth of beats by himself in a single year.

artists.name: David Chief
artists.why: DJ, producer and one of Burlington’s foremost tastemakers.

artists.name: Loupo
artists.why: Montpelier producer working in sample-based soul hip-hop.

artists.name: YETI MANE
artists.why: “Custom canvases for quality rap music. No hustle, all work. 802.”

artists.name: Wombaticus Rex
artists.why: Northeast Kingdom representative, back ten years later to finish the job.

artists.name: FOZ.
artists.why: Burlington emcee and producer.

artists.name: Omega Jade
artists.why: Emcee, poet and Burlington School District teacher, with a Rocket Shop session to her name.

artists.name: SINNN
artists.why: Ghana-born, by way of New York, making hip-hop and afrobeats here now.

artists.name: Pleasant Boys
artists.why: A rap duo out of the Genesis party circuit.

artists.name: tyler serrani
artists.why: One of the upstart names around the Genesis parties, from Castleton to Burlington.

artists.name: Obi the Voicegod
artists.why: Castleton MC off the Genesis circuit, and a repeat Rocket Shop guest.

artists.name: HAKIMXOXO
artists.why: Came up through Burlington house shows and broke out well past them.

artists.name: Real Ricky
artists.why: Dissed the entire 802 scene on one track and made it local news.

artists.name: Rachel Ambaye
artists.why: South Burlington jazz vocalist and bandleader — the name people give for what comes next.

artists.name: Connor Young
artists.why: Burlington trumpeter who leads a jazz quartet and writes folk songs.

artists.name: Ray Vega
artists.why: UVM trumpeter and Friday Night Jazz host, with an Afro-Caribbean ensemble of his own.

artists.name: Astral Underground
artists.why: “Celestial jazz from the dark side of the Enosphere.”

artists.name: Ivamae
artists.why: Ambient indie soul for the emotionally repressed, and a Rocket Shop session.

artists.name: Craig Mitchell
artists.why: Burlington’s house DJ and vocalist, now fronting a six-piece called Motor City.

artists.name: Malcolm Miller
artists.why: A working Burlington club DJ, back on the decks after years away.

artists.name: Sabouyouma
artists.why: Seven-piece Afro-funk led by Guinean balafonist Ousmane Camara.

artists.name: Acqua Mossa
artists.why: A trio built out of long friendships; Dirt made the best-singles list for 2025.

artists.name: Blossom
artists.why: Queer femme hardcore punk — songs of protest and joy, played loud.

artists.name: Torn
artists.why: Hardcore from Burlington, and one of the bands people name when asked who is holding it down.

artists.name: Siskill
artists.why: Named in the same breath as Cooked and Torn when the threads turn to who is playing.

artists.name: Doom Service
artists.why: Called “an unkillable party machine” by Seven Days.

artists.name: Doll Fight!
artists.why: Riot grrrl out of Burlington.

artists.name: Better Things
artists.why: Getting Worse took a year of work with Robot Dog Studio.

artists.name: Swale
artists.why: Ten records in, and they still describe it as songs that are loud and quiet.

artists.name: Villanelles
artists.why: A rock band based in Burlington, in their own words.

artists.name: Barbacoa
artists.why: Instrumental surf and garage, Burlington’s longest-running kind.

artists.name: Waylon Speed
artists.why: Formed at a Burlington honky-tonk and never quite left it.

artists.name: Doctor Rick
artists.why: Turns up in every favourite-local-band thread; the catalogue is mostly live sets from Nectar’s and Foam.

artists.name: The Burning Sun
artists.why: Mystical adventure rock, their words.

artists.name: My Own Sweet
artists.why: Tim Lauben, Chris Kelly, Kurt Herrmann and Dave Mersch.

artists.name: Huffy
artists.why: The other Tim Lauben band, and the one people still bring up.

artists.name: Anachronist
artists.why: Original indie rock from the centre of the state.

artists.name: The Snaz
artists.why: Brattleboro’s, and touring on it since they were teenagers.

artists.name: Sad Turtle
artists.why: Introspective rhythmic songs with silly names.

artists.name: Wren Kitz
artists.why: Songwriter and field recordist — the guitar and the tape machine get equal billing.

artists.name: Bleach Day
artists.why: Analog-obsessed producers Vinny Marksohn and Louie Kiley.

artists.name: Freddie Losambe
artists.why: South Burlington, twelve records deep; Nevermore landed near the top of the 2025 lists.

artists.name: VT Union
artists.why: The seminal Burlington rap group, and where Nastee came up.

artists.name: Yung Breeze
artists.why: MC and producer out of southern Vermont; Time Capsule is his record with D.FRENCH.

artists.name: Brian McCarthy
artists.why: One of the local lions the jazz scene names when it lists its own.

artists.name: Saturn People's Sound Collective
artists.why: A creative big band, and one of the ensembles the scene points at.

artists.name: The Cheddar Band
artists.why: Soul-funk, fronted by Janéa Hudson.

artists.name: Slob Drop
artists.why: Vermont punk, filed by the band itself under comedy.

artists.name: Robbery
artists.why: Montpelier punk, and a name that turns up whenever the DIY threads start.

artists.name: James Kochalka Superstar
artists.why: Vermont’s former cartoonist laureate, with a rock band.

artists.name: Kate Kush
artists.why: Queer dance floors all over town.

artists.name: CHEETATAH
artists.why: The self-crowned Queen of Groove — disco and funk floors, benefit gigs in the parks.

artists.name: GAYBAR
artists.why: DJ and party in one account; Burlington queer nightlife announces here.

artists.name: Disco Phantom
artists.why: Brian Nagle's Feel Good Jams — a Waking Windows and Monkey House fixture.

artists.name: Kwame Vibe
artists.why: Kwame Dankwa's DJ nights and block parties across town.

artists.name: Deejay Jahred
artists.why: Dancehall and Caribbean nights.

artists.name: DJ Chic
artists.why: Working Burlington club DJ.

artists.name: That Bounce
artists.why: Dance parties, posted gig by gig.

artists.name: For The Record DJs
artists.why: The all-vinyl crew.

artists.name: DJ Tricky Pat
artists.why: Runs Sparkomatik, the monthly drum-and-bass night in Winooski.

artists.name: Vetica
artists.why: Melodic techno from the local synth crowd; debut out on No Fun In Techno.

artists.name: DJ Ghost
artists.why: Burlington club DJ; a quiet feed, not a quiet calendar.
